title: Maximum restricted decision tree depth
statement: Given a finite family of Boolean functions, a set $J$ of coordinates, and a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$, the maximum restricted decision tree depth is the maximum, over the family, of the functions’ restricted decision tree depths with $J$ and $z$ fixed.
